gate_b_requirements: pre-tax no_tax_roi primary; tax-adjusted ROI secondary
nominal/effective M, actual draw count and stake; saturated cells are one allocation, not duplicate WOR
outcome_boundary: No result, score, final SP, payout, tax, ROI, settlement or post-kickoff field is read or emitted. Gate B is NOT_RUN until this exact Gate-A package is accepted.

sampling.probability_vector: Q_WEIGHT = normalized outcome-unexposed q=p_cal×predicted_SP per leg
sampling.saturation_rule: effective_M=min(nominal_M,3^N); coverage_fraction=effective_M/(3^N); nominal rows with FULL_SPACE_SATURATED share one actual full-space allocation per identity and seed
sampling.tax: Gate B only; each winning ¥2 ticket is an independent tax unit; no issue/policy pooling

scope: historical paper-only research; no purchase, production, betting or promotion authority

selection.analysis_unit: complete lottery issue_instance issue@fold; native pool/segment retained only as provenance, never as a selection or settlement boundary
selection.candidate_rule: p_min <= 0.20, ranked by p_min then match_idx then match_id across complete issue_instance
selection.companion_rule: N-1 highest-E_SP other matches with E_SP >= 3.00 across the complete issue_instance
selection.identity_rule: sort candidate plus companions by descending E_SP, ascending p_min, match_idx, match_id; deduplicate selected match-id tuples once per complete issue_instance

n7_bridge_audit.corrected_rule: #159 candidates, companions, GM filter, and dedup applied once over complete issue_instance
n7_bridge_audit.legacy_rule: #127 accepted target identities selected within native pool/segment
